documents.title: Rest before exams
documents.text: Alternate work with short breaks. Keep regular sleep and make time to recover.

documents.title: Reduce study anxiety
documents.text: Break a large task into manageable steps. Ask for support if you are struggling.

documents.title: Plan your study workload
documents.text: Spread preparation across several days and leave spare time.

documents.title: Check the submission deadline
documents.text: Find the date and time in the current submission rules.

documents.title: Arrange a deadline extension
documents.text: Check how to obtain approval for a later submission.

documents.title: Check the car battery
documents.text: Compare signs of a flat battery with your car's behaviour.

documents.title: Check the car starter
documents.text: Investigate possible reasons the engine will not start.
